prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic candid street-food portrait at a busy nighttime city market.
prompt.main_subject: One generic approved adult woman with long red hair and sunglasses resting on her head, biting into a grilled-food skewer. She wears an orange lace-up crop top with secure coverage, a matching orange mini skirt, and knee-high boots, with a casual playful expression.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical three-quarter-body eye-level framing. Place the adult subject beside a food stall with the skewer visible in her hand, warm cooking lights, food trays, neon signs kept unreadable, pedestrians and city bokeh filling the background.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Night ambient city light mixed with warm food-stall illumination, colorful neon reflections, shallow depth of field, lively urban street-market atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic vertical street photography, DSLR with 35mm f/1.8 lens, eye-level perspective, sharp subject focus, realistic food steam and fabric texture, natural low-light grain, no watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic vertical three-quarter-body street-food portrait of one generic approved adult woman with long red hair and sunglasses resting on her head, biting into a grilled-food skewer beside a busy nighttime city food stall. She wears an orange lace-up crop top with secure coverage, a matching orange mini skirt and knee-high boots, with a casual playful expression. Neon lights, warm food-stall lamps, food trays, pedestrians and city bokeh fill the background. Cinematic street photography, vibrant but natural colors, shallow depth of field, DSLR 35mm f/1.8 look, realistic food and fabric detail, no readable text, logos or watermark.
